defs.def: important, enjoyable, interesting, etc; worth spending time, money or effort on 重要的；令人愉快的；有趣的；值得花时间（或花钱、努力等）

ex.s: It is worthwhile to be a perfectionistB.
ex.t: 做一个完美主义者是值得的 B.

ex.s: Want to explore new cultures，meet new people and do something worthwhile at the same time?
ex.t: 想探索新文化、结识新朋友，同时做点有意义的事吗？

ex.s: Even though being a scout has its challenges, I feel it is worthwhile.
ex.t: 尽管当童子军有种种挑战，我觉得它还是值得的。

ex.s: Is it something worthwhile to do?
ex.t: 这是一件值得做的事吗？

ex.s: Do you think it was worthwhile?
I think this life-changing experience is certainly worthwhile, and I hope my child will study abroad in the future.
ex.t: 我认为这段改变人生的经历肯定是值得的，并且我希望我的孩子将来能出国留学。

ex.s: I think (that) this life-changing experience is certainly worthwhile, and I hope (that) my child will study abroad in the future.
ex.t: 我认为（that）这段改变人生的经历肯定是值得的，并且我希望（that）我的孩子将来能出国留学。
